gates.acceptance: Review/approve PR #70 and PR #58; configure a pinned registry path and VAIXLNS_API_TOKEN on the API/bridge hosts; verify authenticated inventory and deterministic route previews; retain dispatch_allowed=false until each tool has explicit identity, capability, endpoint, receipt, independent replay and separate admission evidence.

gates.problem: VAIXLNS-unified main currently exposes read-only vx.health/status/capabilities tools. Open draft PR #58 adds authenticated office inventory and proposal-only route preview; neither a live office dispatch path nor arbitrary external-tool connectivity is established.
gates.acceptance: Review PR #58 and require CI green; set VAIXLNS_OFFICE_REGISTRY_PATH to a pinned approved registry and VAIXLNS_API_TOKEN on both API and bridge hosts; verify MCP initialize/list/call, authenticated office inventory, deterministic route preview, timeout/redaction/fail-closed behavior; require dispatch_allowed=false for unadmitted tools and add real dispatch only through a separate reviewed VX execution/evidence gate.

gates.problem: verbose-engine PR #7 cannot reach its tests because the main tree contains a deeply nested malformed imported path that makes actions/checkout fail. PR #8 preserves its source commit/subtree/path inventory and removes the malformed path from the proposed current tree; CSD runtime implementation remains unverified.
gates.acceptance: PR #8 checkout succeeds and all Python package plus CSD structural audit tests run; report test results separately from checkout recovery; do not promote CSD kernel implementation without executable evidence.

operational_phases.name: Pin inventory
operational_phases.outcome: Immutable repository refs, tree digests, manifests, contracts, entrypoints, tests and CI results.

operational_phases.name: Resolve identity and contracts
operational_phases.outcome: Two candidate identity mappings are either evidenced or remain blocked; no inferred aliases.

operational_phases.name: Run local verification
operational_phases.outcome: Repository-native tests and negative cases pass on pinned SHAs; receipts include run links and artifact digests.

operational_phases.name: Connect isolated adapters
operational_phases.outcome: Local/read-only cross-system smoke tests pass; unknown identity and bad signatures fail closed.

operational_phases.name: Prove persistence and replay
operational_phases.outcome: Durable receipt survives restart; retry is idempotent; independent replay matches original deterministic output.

operational_phases.name: Governed admission
operational_phases.outcome: Independent reviewer accepts evidence and VAIXLNS grants bounded authority for exact source/environment.

operational_phases.name: Stage operation
operational_phases.outcome: Health, lease, controlled isolation, recovery, re-route, telemetry and rollback evidence pass.

operational_phases.name: Production decision
operational_phases.outcome: Separate approval after security, auth, secrets, backup/restore, capacity, observability and load gates pass.
